title: Machine Guns
text:
Walkthrough

When you see the two turrets, you will need to manipulate either one so that they can shoot the other. Next, jump onto the center platform, and step into the beam cast by the upper turret. After a certain delay, the turret will fire and move. When the beam is toughed enough times, it will destroy the left turret, allowing you to proceed.

After that, you will also be introduced to anti-gravity. It is activated by a button and shuts off through a timer. You have to move to one box to the left, and then the other to the top of the slope. Next, run left and jump over the button, and climb the left box. The field should activate, lifting the left box above you. When it stops, you can push the box further left to the ladder, and climb up. After that, release the right-hand ladder.

Finally, move the lower box again to the right, and quickly reach the first box to pull it to the right (at least a far as being above the platform), then position the box below the exit. Next, set the anti-gravity box one more time, and stand on the upper crate, and when it floats, you can jump through the door to the exit.
